_meta.source: Curated from public administrative lists; see data/geo/MANIFEST.json for per-table sources, licenses and checksums
_meta.license: Compilation: project-internal; underlying sources: Wikipedia CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution required), OSM ODbL 1.0 (attribution required), synthetic fixtures (no license restrictions)
_meta.limitations: Not an official KATO/OSM address register. Covers all 17 oblasts, 3 cities of republican significance and 90 cities of Kazakhstan by name/alias only (no street-level or house-level data). Microdistrict coverage is a small verified subset (Almaty only). Cities with in-city districts: Almaty, Astana, Shymkent, Karaganda, Aktobe. Never cite as nationwide address coverage.
_meta.usage: Runtime is fully offline. Every record carries provenance/source. Enrich via scripts/import_gazetteer_csv.py, then refresh MANIFEST checksums.
